verdict.rationale: The docs point developers to a first-party Batch Processing API for high-volume customer processing and describe asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios, so a bulk ingestion path exists. Nothing documents tracking a batch's progress or status, item-level failure reporting, or resuming after a partial failure, and bulk transaction import is not covered. Exports, webhook idempotency keys, and external-identifier lookups are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: batch job status/progress tracking, per-record error reporting, resume/retry after partial failure, bulk transaction import, independent or hands-on corroboration.
